notebook.geometry_observation: After a one-shot jump to image cells, previously unmeasured code/output heights expand and move the target outside the viewport. In 02 training-plot the cell begins at CSS y=4480 while viewport ends at y=820. The offscreen output is consequently unmounted until further scrolling.
limitations: Copies were outside the original project, so original project discovery/LSP workload is not measured.
Cold measurements include application startup; warm measurements start from an already displayed text editor.
Scroll-to-image durations include deliberate 100ms intervals between 300px wheel inputs, and are not image decode latency.
Earlier image probes incorrectly assumed that a one-shot cell jump left its image in the viewport; their timeouts are retained and are not counted as successful tests.
notebook.image_probe_status: All requested images became visible and decoded after actual wheel input in the final diagnostic run.
